decisions.reason: The newly purchased campaign domain may be intended for the Gmail-compatible mailbox, but the source does not explicitly establish it as the mailbox domain.

Domain registration does not change the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method or lifecycle.
The purchased domain does not change MeetAlfred configuration or its selected subscription plan.
The domain purchase does not alter or resume the deferred Zapier configuration.
Registering a domain does not change the restrictions on using production leads or identities for testing.
The domain purchase does not affect preservation of existing MeetAlfred integrations or campaigns.
